versions.content: If the API for modifying the RAM block status has been disabled in configuration (via NvMSetRamBlockStatusApi or NvMBlockUseSetRamBlockStatus) the NvM module shall treat a RAM block as invalid when reading data from NV block, i.e. during NvM_ReadAll, the NvM module shall copy each NVRAM block to RAM if configured accordingly.
